tool.name: Search Accounts
tool.description: Search rows from the Accounts dataset via list-dataset-rows. Supports server-side search (q/search) + filters, with optional client-side field-scoped refinement. Defaults starshipId to env('STARSHIP_ID').

q.description: Optional search string (alias of `search`). Passed to the server for dataset row search.

fields.description: Optional list of fields to refine `q` client-side (only applied when provided; otherwise server-side search is used as-is).

search.description: Optional search string. Passed to the server for dataset row search.

filters.description:
Optional server-side row filters for list-dataset-rows.

Loosely typed: can be an object map, an array of filter objects, or a JSON string (and will be passed through to the connector as-is). See datasets docs for supported operators/shape.
